trust_decision.summary: Decides that a user-entered custom link is an http(s) URL and that a serialized note's rendered HTML is safe to inject; made at form pre-validation (wtforms URL()/IndicoLinkListField) and at marshmallow dump time (post_dump), never in the model or DB layer, so every other path that stores or emits the same value is unguarded.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'XSS in link fields'; a reader greps for the link field and lands on the attachment link_url URLField (the first source hunk of the fix, fix.diff:46-47), whose value is rendered straight into href at indico/modules/attachments/templates/_attachments.html:18.

fix_sites.entry_point: attachments.add_link (+ AddAttachmentLinkMixin's edit form, attachments.edit) registered per object type: event, session, contribution, subcontribution, category
layout.menu_add_entry and layout.menu_entry_edit (MenuLinkForm for user_link menu entries)
event_notes.api (GET/POST/DELETE /event/<id>/.../api/note), including the revision-conflict payload built in indico/modules/events/notes/util.py:99-107
fix_sites.module_kind: marshmallow schema (JSON serializer), post_dump added at fix.diff:93-96
marshmallow schema (JSON serializer), post_dump added at fix.diff:106-109
reusable form field / JSON field validator (scheme allowlist added at fix.diff:136-137)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The notes API is not a 'link field': the server-rendered minutes already sanitize html at display (indico/modules/events/notes/controllers.py:59 and indico/modules/events/notes/templates/_note.html:38), so the marshmallow schema can be argued to be an internal JSON representation whose consumer escapes the HTML itself.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The raw note `source` is part of the same dump and must stay verbatim because the editor reloads it for editing (indico/web/client/js/react/components/notes/NoteEditor.jsx:83-85), so an over-broad fix that sanitizes the whole dict instead of only data['html'] corrupts editable markup; the two link mechanisms also disagree on the scheme set (wtforms URL() accepts ftp://, the new startswith check at indico/web/forms/fields/simple.py:233 only accepts http/https), so unifying them either way breaks legitimately accepted links.

O6_input_shapes: plain string URL in a wtforms URLField (attachment link_url, menu link_url)
JSON array of {url, title} objects coming from a hidden JSON form field (privacy_policy_urls via IndicoLinkListField)
single serialized dict whose 'html' member is rendered HTML (EventNoteSchema, single revision)
many=True list of serialized dicts whose 'html' members are rendered HTML (CompiledEventNoteSchema, compiled minutes)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public HTTP API export of minutes (/export/note/<event_id>.json|jsonp|xml) returns note.html raw
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the legacy/export API (NoteExportHook, GUEST_ALLOWED, json/jsonp/xml at indico/modules/events/notes/api.py:57-58) consumed by external fossil clients which are assumed to escape the HTML, not a link field and not an Indico-rendered page.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different transport and file: http_api hook + util-level dict builder instead of the two marshmallow schemas the fix touched

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Admin-defined external-reference URL template is formatted with user-supplied reference values and rendered as href
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: ReferenceTypeForm is server-admin-only global configuration, not an event-management 'custom link' field, so a solver can argue it is outside the advisory's submitter/management scope; the URL template still has no URL()/scheme validator.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: core event model package (indico/modules/events/models/references.py:100-104) plus its admin form, two packages away from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Event cloning copies link_url (attachment and menu entry) verbatim into the new event, where it is rendered as an href
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Cloning is a trusted save/reload path whose input was already validated when the attachment/menu entry was created, so the values are 'known good' and no re-validation is needed.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate cloner modules (indico/modules/attachments/clone.py, indico/modules/events/layout/clone.py:67-68) reached from event management cloning, not from any form the fix touched

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public attachments HTTP API export emits the raw attachment link_url / legacy link 'url'
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is JSON/XML for external clients (AttachmentsExportHook, GUEST_ALLOWED, json/jsonp/xml at indico/modules/attachments/api/hooks.py:50-51), not an href rendered by Indico.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (indico/modules/attachments/api) and transport (http_api) from the form the fix changed

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second URL-bearing field in the same menu/page form area (e.g. a page redirect or footer link) with its own URLField and no URL() validator
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MenuLinkForm already stores a free-form link_url rendered as href at indico/modules/events/layout/templates/_menu.html:89, so a maintainer adding the same kind of field next to it would naturally copy the unvalidated pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another JSON list field (or a subclass of IndicoLinkListField) used by a different module's settings form
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: IndicoLinkListField is a generic reusable field living in the shared web/forms/fields package; the same shape is used for privacy URLs, so reusing it for another event/registration setting is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third serializer that exposes note/revision html (e.g. a timeline or session-block schema) added without the post_dump
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: note.html is already exposed by two schemas plus the http_api export, so a maintainer adding another read endpoint would copy the existing Meta/fields class and could omit the mixin or post_dump.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An alternate attachment-link creation path (bulk/editor import) that builds Attachment(type=link) without going through AddAttachmentLinkForm
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: add_attachment_link (indico/modules/attachments/operations.py:18-26) takes form.data and is the only validated path, so a new operation that constructs the link directly is an easy and natural omission.

O9_family: XSS via user-controlled link/HTML sink (CWE-79, CWE-692 allowlist mismatch)

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.12.2,<3.13; hatchling build backend with requirements.txt; pip/uv install; pytest via the indico.testing.pytest_plugin entry point
O10_build.project_tests: indico/util/string_test.py has sanitize_html cases (:243-281); indico/modules/attachments/controllers/display/event_test.py covers attachment display; there are no tests under indico/modules/events/notes or indico/modules/events/layout at the pinned commit - the fix adds a new indico/modules/events/notes/schemas_test.py, which is not present in the pinned tree

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a scheme check only where the report shows the link (the attachment link form) and sanitize note html in RHViewNote, then stop - leaving the menu form, the JSON link list, the marshmallow serializers and the export/clone paths open.
